name: FromNarrative
title: Narrative Conformance Statements
description: Conformance statements found throughout the narrative of the IG consolidated into this computable resource for traceability purposes

statement.requirement: The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** keep every version of a Task and **SHALL** support `vread` and instance history (`GET Task/[id]/_history`), so that every state of a Task can be retrieved.
When a Task's status, business status or outputs change, the RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** record the change as a new version of the same Task (same `Task.id`, new `meta.versionId`).
Clients **SHALL** update the existing Task to record progress, change its status or add outputs, and **SHALL NOT** create a new Task for these purposes.

Clients **SHALL** create a new Task only for a new request (for example a question, an invoice or a labelling round) or after a terminal status, and **SHALL** link it to the related Task with `Task.basedOn` and the same `Task.groupIdentifier`.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support versioned updates and **SHALL** reject a Task update whose `If-Match` version is not the current version.
Clients **SHALL** send `If-Match` with the version they last read when updating a Task.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support conditional create (`If-None-Exist`) on `Task.identifier`.
The Applicant Client **SHOULD** use conditional create with the Task instance identifier when creating a Task, so that a retried request does not create a duplicate Task.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL NOT** allow Tasks to be deleted; a Task and its history are the audit trail of a regulatory procedure.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support searching Tasks by `identifier`, `group-identifier`, `owner`, `requester`, `status` and `based-on`.

The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support the `input` search parameter defined by this guide and the core `output` search parameter, with `_include=Task:input` and `_include=Task:output`, so that a client can retrieve a Task with its documents in one request.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support searching DocumentReferences by `identifier` with the `of-type` modifier, so that all versions of a document can be found by its document set identifier.

Clients **SHALL** upload document content as a Binary before creating the DocumentReference that points to it, and **SHALL** reference the DocumentReference, not the Binary, from `Task.input` and `Task.output`.

When creating a new version of a document, clients **SHALL** keep its document set identifier, assign a new document version identifier, and **SHOULD** point to the previous version with `DocumentReference.relatesTo` (`replaces`).
The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support transaction Bundles, so that a Binary, its DocumentReference and the Task can be submitted together.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support topic-based Subscriptions on the Task status-change and Task-creation topics, with the `rest-hook` channel and both `id-only` and `full-resource` content.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support every search parameter that its SubscriptionTopics use as a filter; in this guide these are Task `identifier` and Task `owner`.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support the Subscription `$status` operation and **SHOULD** support `$events`.
The Applicant Client **SHOULD** create its Task status-change Subscription, filtered by the Task identifier, when it creates the Task.
The Notification Receiver **SHALL** accept subscription notification Bundles POSTed to its registered Endpoint address and **SHALL** respond with an HTTP 2xx status when a notification is received.

The Notification Receiver **SHALL** treat a notification about a Task as an update of that Task (same `Task.id`), and **SHOULD** retrieve the current version of the Task when the notification content is `id-only`.
The Notification Receiver **SHOULD** use notification event numbers to detect missed notifications, and **SHOULD** recover them with `$events` or by reading the Task.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** create a Provenance resource for every create or update of a Task, targeting that version of the Task.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support searching Provenance by `target` and `_revinclude=Provenance:target` on Task searches.
All interactions with the RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** be authorized using SMART Backend Services (system-level scopes, JWT bearer tokens).
The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** limit each applicant organization to the Tasks in which it is requester or owner, and to the documents linked to those Tasks.

The Applicant Client **SHALL** be able to create submission Tasks as requester, and **SHALL** be able to update Tasks it owns (such as question, invoice and labelling Tasks), adding its responses as outputs.

The Regulator Client **SHALL** be able to update Tasks it owns, setting status and business status and adding outputs such as acknowledgments, validation reports and decisions, and **SHALL** be able to create child Tasks owned by the applicant.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** reject an update that changes a Task's `requester`, `owner`, `groupIdentifier` or Task instance identifier after the Task has been created.

The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** send each notification as a Bundle of type `subscription-notification` whose first entry is a SubscriptionStatus that identifies the Subscription and, for event notifications, gives `eventsSinceSubscriptionStart` and each event's `eventNumber` and `focus`. The topic **SHOULD** be included for `full-resource` content and **MAY** be included for `id-only` content.
The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** send a `handshake` notification when a Subscription is activated, and **SHOULD** send `heartbeat` notifications when the Subscription specifies a `heartbeatPeriod`.

For `id-only` content, `notificationEvent.focus` **SHALL** reference the Task and the Bundle **SHALL** include an entry for the Task with `fullUrl`, `request` and `response` but no resource. For `full-resource` content, the Bundle **SHALL** include the current version of the Task. In both cases `additionalContext` **SHOULD** reference related resources, such as the parent Task.

The Notification Receiver **SHALL** accept `handshake`, `heartbeat` and `event-notification` notifications with an HTTP 2xx status, **SHALL** process event notifications, and **SHOULD** ignore or reject notifications for a Subscription that its own system did not create.

The Notification Receiver **SHOULD** verify that a `full-resource` notification comes from the RWI-pharma Server, for example using a secret supplied in the Subscription, before acting on its content.
